voice-branch-jargon.notes: Most of the docs/audits citations were removed, but the branch vocabulary is largely intact. Workstream label: "the unit is the open content of **R2-core**", "this closes **R2-core**'s unit", "a derivation closes **R2-core**'s unit" -- defined nowhere in the paper. The repository as the paper's name for itself: "The binding generating function enters **the corpus** only formally" and "data-blind on the **current corpus**". A timestamped working note as a heading: "**Fibre-level refinement (bar-parity, 2026-07-25).**". An agent scratch artifact: "recorded exactly at orders $n = 1$ through $6$ in the **exploration witness**". Audit-tier vocabulary: "Second, **at measured tier**" and "promote the $u \equiv 1$ alignment **from measured to derived**". And a tracked research lead: "a refutation **removes the lead**".
